title: Schwelle / information ring and headline connector
slide_intent: Let geometry support the message’s structure so the same identity system can inform and persuade.
strategic_value: The repeated-bar rhythm can connect an infographic with DB campaign typography.
demonstration: A circular bar diagram on dark ground sits beside a traveler photograph with the red Schwelle joining STRESS and ZEIT.
practical_value: Compare a radial information arrangement with a linear headline connection.

content_islands.name: Radial graphic
content_islands.spec: Arrange bars around a ring at left, with a red segment.

content_islands.name: Headline connection
content_islands.spec: Place the red sequence between the large white words over the photograph at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The pair applies the bar language to a circular graphic and a campaign headline.
reference_purposes.Expression: Both use a repeated thin-to-thick bar rhythm.
